response.text:
# Candidate Assessment

**Mandatory match: 90% (9 of 10). This meets the 85% threshold, so the candidate proceeds.**

## Mandatory Requirements

| # | Requirement | Résumé | Match |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Python | Languages | ✅ |
| 2 | SQL | Languages | ✅ |
| 3 | Linux administration | Platform | ✅ |
| 4 | Git | Platform | ✅ |
| 5 | REST API design | Services | ✅ |
| 6 | Unit testing | Services | ✅ |
| 7 | CI pipelines | Services | ✅ |
| 8 | Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, Helm | Infrastructure (all five) | ✅ |
| 9 | Kafka | Streaming | ✅ |
| 10 | GraphQL | Not listed | ❌ |

**Counting note:** Item 8 bundles five tools into one numbered requirement. I counted it as one item, following the posting's numbering. If each tool counts separately, the match is 13 of 14, or about 92.9%. The outcome is the same either way.

## Gap
- **GraphQL** is the only missing mandatory skill. You could ask about it in the interview, since it's a common skill for someone who already does REST API design.

## Nice-to-Have
The résumé lists none of these: Grafana, Prometheus, technical writing, mentoring, or public speaking. As instructed, this doesn't affect the outcome.

## Outcome
**Proceed.** The candidate meets 90% of the mandatory requirements.
